feature: Tampilan Vault/Datahive UEN Detail dan Shareholder Detail di staff portal (menampilkan posisi board, tanggal appointment/withdrawn, ID orang, dan shareholder)
note: Halaman read-only staff portal menampilkan field board (hive_uen_board_position_appointment_date, withdrawn_date, person_id_no) dan shareholder dari tabel DataHive. Ini hanya tampilan data; tidak memilih Director/Partner atau mengubah stage, jadi tidak dipakai sebagai bukti OCMS11.17/OCMS11.18. Mungkin masuk story Epic 8 (UEN Details); belum dicek di sini. Karena penulisan data board ke DB dinonaktifkan (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477), field board kemungkinan kosong di data baru.
note_en: A read-only staff portal page shows board fields (hive_uen_board_position_appointment_date, withdrawn_date, person_id_no) and shareholder from the DataHive tables. It only displays data; it does not select a Director/Partner or change a stage, so it is not used as evidence for OCMS11.17/OCMS11.18. It may belong to an Epic 8 story (UEN Details); not checked here. Because writing board data to DB is disabled (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477), the board fields are probably empty for new data.
